checklist.statement: The UI does not save until a purpose is chosen.
checklist.note: When configuring a Multi Judge panel on an Expectation in Judge Configuration (#judges), the Multi Judge purpose dropdown defaults to 'Choose explicitly…'. Leaving it unselected blocks second judge configuration, displays 'Form incomplete — choose: Multi Judge purpose, Judge 2 model, Judge 2 confidence_source', and keeps Review & Apply disabled (evidence://ct-rui-003-multi-no-purpose-form.png). Selecting an explicit choice ('independence') immediately enables second judge fields and Review & Apply, proposing a YAML diff with 'purpose: independence' (evidence://ct-rui-003-multi-with-purpose.png, evidence://ct-rui-003-multi-diff-preview.png). Authoring a multi_judge panel without 'purpose' directly in the Workspace YAML editor is refused by UI preflight checks with 'Volume XV / Volume VI / Appendix A.7: Multi Judge MUST declare an explicit purpose: independence or stability.' and 'must have required property \'purpose\'' (evidence://ct-rui-003-yaml-multijudge-no-purpose.png), blocking Apply. Engine GET responses and workspace SHA-256 before and after confirm that nothing was saved and no default purpose was ever chosen by the UI.

notes: Verified across Judge Configuration form interaction, diff generation preview, direct Workspace YAML authoring refusal, and before/after verification of workspace SHA-256 and read-only engine GET responses.
